Name: Fruit Straw Hats - for Json Assets and Fashion Sense
Author: momoslime
Description:
Some cute new hats I threw together bc I wanted more peach-themed items in the game!  Other fruits included :)

Two versions available--[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].  Both require the respective mods!

Installation:

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]
[*]Drag the mod folder (prefix [JA] for Json Assets and [FS] for Fashion sense) into your mods folder (for Steam: Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
[*]Enjoy!  Json Assets version can be bought at the hat mouse or cheated in via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿.  Fashion Sense version can be equipped via the Hand Mirror at Pierre's store!
[/list]
